_comment: Film 63 clip slots (clip-auftrag-imac.md, 24.11.2026; C2 'We must build' dropped). The iMac cuts <ROOT>clips/Cn.mp4 with ~1 s pre-/post-roll. clips_wav.py trims each file to [in, out] (seconds inside the mp4): null = automatic (first voiced 10-ms frame - 0.15 s, last voiced + 0.25 s, -40 dBFS); cut_pause_after = cut at the first pause >= 0.15 s after that many seconds of speech (C1: only 'Artificial intelligence needs to be disarmed.', not 'The word is strong, I know.'). After the first rebuild LISTEN to clipwav/Cn.wav and set in/out by hand if needed (clips-zeiten.txt from the iMac). placeholder = expected length while the file is missing. cues = subtitle lines (verified wording, wortlaut-verifiziert.md); words are spread over the clip's voiced span. 25.11.: in/out set from clips-zeiten.txt (speech 1.0-x s inside the iMac cut) with 0.2 s handles; real files read from /tmp/claude-0/f63/clips/ (project folder only has .gz copies).
